newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 10.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 10.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net misses in its reserve projections, a Fed spokesman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 1/3 of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the small banks, while about 2/3 of the borrowing was done by the money centers. No borrowing was done by the large regionals.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, all of the borrowing was done by the small banks.
The high in natural float was about $1.9 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $425 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $50 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $200 million primarily due to fog in the Maine and Buffalo areas, and weather-related delays in other areas.
